source_equations.meaning: m_t=m_i+m_e; incoming momentum equals outgoing momentum; incoming kinetic energy equals outgoing kinetic energy plus I.
g1 is scattered electron relative to the center of mass of ejected electron plus ion; g2 is ejected electron relative to ion.

source_equations.formula: d3sigma/(dUpsilon dOmega1 dOmega2); angular coordinates are directions of g1 and g2.
G=1/(16*pi^2) with independently uniform directions g1 and g2
source_equations.limitation: Not independent laboratory outgoing-electron angles, not measured/calibrated angular distribution.

source_equations.energy_owner: E is the relative collision energy defined by Eq7, not an unrelated laboratory table.

adopted_joint_model.energy_law: p(Upsilon|E)=I*E/((E-I)*Upsilon^2), I<=Upsilon<=E; cross section vanishes for E<=I
adopted_joint_model.mass_convention: Newtonian additive kinetic masses with a separate internal ionization energy; h is not the physical neutral rest mass including binding-energy mass defect.
adopted_joint_model.labels: s and e are source bookkeeping labels. Inclusive electron observables sum both products once; optional label exchange does not double the event rate.
adopted_joint_model.energy_partition: At finite mass Upsilon-I is relative Jacobi energy of ejected electron and ion. It is not the laboratory kinetic energy of the ejected electron.
adopted_joint_model.temperature_convention: Paper omits Boltzmann constant; use theta=k_B*T in SI implementation.
adopted_joint_model.symmetric_electron_pair_jacobi_warning: A uniform angular density in a different Jacobi system is a different model. Do not transport the same Upsilon law and isotropy unchanged and call it source equivalent.
adopted_joint_model.exactness: Pointwise mass/momentum/kinetic-plus-I conservation is exact for these adopted Newtonian masses. Angular/source calibration, physical recoil distribution and relativistic binding-mass effects remain outside admission.
